turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me: who decided that, and when?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a number from a machine, and the company that makes it prints in its own guide that it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. I have that page in my bag. I asked who decided, Hale, not what the software thinks.
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm walking to the principal's office the minute I leave this room anyway. Put the referral in writing and copy me on it. And you still haven't told me who decided on that zero.
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow's fine, I'll be there before you. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. Explain that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written answer on who decided to enter it and why nobody called me first as your own procedure requires. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided and why no one called her; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her a document she could check.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and then threatened to take it to the office, which gave her a number the software maker itself says not to rely on alone and a threat she was already planning to beat you to.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since the only thing you offered was the score; that sighting proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and why no one called, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you contacted her, then put something dated and tied to Owen's own work in front of her before you ever mention the checker.
